query:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(u.display_name), ''), 'Somebody') AS "name!"
              FROM conversation_departures d
              JOIN channels c ON c.id = d.channel_id
              JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
             WHERE d.channel_id = $1 AND c.channel_type = 'dm'
             ORDER BY d.left_at
             LIMIT 1
